messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: eu-west-1 GPU pool backpressure detected — queue depth rising > 120s p99 for inference requests. Auto-scaling attempted 3x in last 5m and failed to clear queue. Paging SRE oncall. :rotating_light:
chris (sre-oncall): acknowledged, looking now. tagging infra and runtime. I see elevated preemptions + pending pods in the pool.
maria (infra): logs show node eviction churn from cloud provider spot reclaim -> kube autoscaler stalled due to pod disruption budgets. kube-events excerpt:
```
Pod evicted: gpu-worker-xyz, reason: Preemption
Autoscaler: scaleUp rejected - pending resourceLimits
```
josh (eng-runtime): can we failover requests to the fallback model variant (cpu-optimized) for low-priority routes? if we can route chat/embedding low-priority to fallback it might reduce pressure.
anika (product): we have 2 paying customers on heavy batch jobs right now (cust A + cust B). Anika here — reaching out to CSMs to warn; need a quick customer-impact estimate.
liam (capacity): starting emergency scale: requesting immediate launch of on-demand GPU instances in eu-west-1 while we stabilize. Command I'm executing: 
```
# trigger capacity pool expand
rdw infra scale-gpu-pool --region eu-west-1 --pool inference-gpu-pool --type on-demand --count 8
```
chris (sre-oncall): noted. also initiating regional fallback routing to eu-central for new requests to spread load. Adding a temporary rate limit for non-critical background ingestion.
maria (infra): FYI the cloud quota for GPUs in eu-west-1 is near limit, that's why autoscaler can't provision. I'm opening quota request but that'll take time. For now I'll drain some non-critical workloads and shift batch jobs to west-eu-spot pool.
josh (eng-runtime): implementing gradual model-variant downgrade for search/embeddings on a per-route basis to lessen KV cache pressure; pushing config change now: 
```
routes:
  /v1/generate: model_priority: [gpt-large-q4, gpt-large-q2, gpt-medium-cpu]
  /v1/embed:   model_priority: [embed-xl, embed-xl-cpu]
```
chris (sre-oncall): handoff to night oncall in 40m — will summarize state and action items. tagging devops-bot to create incident page.
devops-bot: Created incident page RDW-INC-2026-1387 and Slack incident channel #incident-1783004444-inc. Log links: https://internal.redwood/incidents/RDW-INC-2026-1387. Incident severity: SEV2.
anika (product): customer impact: cust A saw 35% error rate for their synchronous inference calls between 14:02–14:25 UTC. cust B reported 5 min tail latencies for batch jobs. Outreach in flight.
liam (capacity): on-demand nodes launched +8, pods scheduled, queue is dropping now. p99 latency moving toward normal. Will monitor next 30m.
maria (infra): cleared several preempted nodes, temporarily relaxed PDBs for non-critical controllers to allow scale-up. Documenting exact changes for postmortem.
chris (sre-oncall): thanks. summary for handoff -> still open: monitor queue, confirm customer outreach receipts, track follow-ups: quota request, better autoscaler handling of PDBs, implement regional fallback policy automation.
--- 45 minutes later ---
chris (sre-oncall): status update before handoff: queue stable but still above baseline. new requests are being routed to eu-central for low-priority routes. Cust A alerted and on a call with CSM. Leaving playbook and runbook notes in incident doc. Handoff to maria for overnight watch.
maria (infra): taking over oncall. I'll keep an eye and escalate if queue re-increases. Next steps I'm owning: open cloud quota ticket (RDW-5423), add autoscaler tuning PR, schedule postmortem.
josh (eng-runtime): creating PR to add model-priority fallback that is rate-limited and observable (RDW-5431).
anika (product): scheduling post-incident review; proposed slot: 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC. I'll invite SRE, Infra, Runtime, Capacity, and Customer Success.
chris (sre-oncall): postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (spot preemption -> quota exhaustion -> autoscaler stall + PDB interactions), mitigation timeline, action items with owners + due dates, and customer impact summary.
maria (infra): action items being tracked in RDW-REM-1783004444 board. current items: 
- RDW-5423: request additional GPU quota for eu-west-1 (owner: maria, due: 2026-03-20)
- RDW-5431: runtime fallback + observability (owner: josh, due: 2026-03-22)
- RDW-5432: autoscaler tuning + PDB guidance (owner: liam, due: 2026-03-19)
- RDW-5433: regional fallback automation for routing (owner: chris, due: 2026-03-25)
- RDW-5434: customer outreach follow-up (owner: anika, due: 2026-03-17)
chris (sre-oncall): adding test/QA item: simulate spot reclaim + quota shortage in staging and verify autoscaler behavior (owner: maria, due: 2026-03-26).
liam (capacity): I'll prep runbook snippet for emergency on-demand expansion and quota failover behavior so oncall can trigger faster (RDW-5435, owner: liam, due: 2026-03-21).
anika (product): noting learning: need faster CS notification template for degraded latency affecting SLAs. I'll draft copy (RDW-5436).
maria (infra): logging final mitigation steps in incident doc and marking severity down to monitoring. leaving a checklist for the night oncall.
chris (sre-oncall): handoff complete. reactions: :white_check_mark: :coffee:
maria (infra): quick note — please add any additional customer tickets to RDW-INC-2026-1387 and flag if they need priority follow-up.
--- next day: remediation follow-up thread ---
anika (product): postmortem scheduled and calendar invite sent. request attendees to add any additional artifacts or logs to the incident doc.
josh (eng-runtime): PR RDW-5431 opened for review with unit tests and new metrics (fallback_rate, fallback_latency).
maria (infra): cloud quota approved in emergency for +20 GPUs (RDW-5423) — planning to request permanent baseline increase.
liam (capacity): autoscaler tuning PR in draft, test infra reproducible scenario added.
anika (product): closing loop: CSMs updated customers; cust A accepted credit and wants follow-up in 2 weeks.
chris (sre-oncall): final note: we handled live mitigation well but need automation for regional failover and clearer autoscaler priorities. Will capture during postmortem.
devops-bot: Incident RDW-INC-2026-1387 marked RESOLVED (duration: ~1h20m). Postmortem doc created: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/RDW-INC-2026-1387.
maria (infra): marking thread for remediation tracking. I'll update RDW-REM-1783004444 board with status changes.
anika (product): thanks everyone — nice coordination under pressure.
